subject: Quick demo: GitHub app + private repo webhooks?
messages:
From: Samir Khalid <samir@openforge.io>
To: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick demo: GitHub app + private repo webhooks?

Hi Avery,

We signed up for a trial earlier this week after reading about Redwood Inference's GitHub integration. We're an OSS-first company (OpenForge) and have a few specific questions before we book a demo:

- Can your GitHub app read private repos in an org with strict SSO?
- How do webhook payloads look for PR events and how configurable are filters?
- Do you support self-hosted runner events and GitHub Actions logs for inference telemetry?

I'd like a short demo and a technical pre-call with an engineer to confirm permissions. We have a couple folks who should join: myself (platform lead), Mira (security), and Rohan (backend). We're PST based.

Attaching a simple architecture diagram and our security questionnaire that you might want to glance at.

(Attachment: openforge-arch-diagram.pdf [PDF, 312KB])
(Attachment: openforge-security-questions.xlsx [XLSX, 48KB])

Thanks,
Samir Khalid
Platform Lead, OpenForge
samir@openforge.io
https://openforge.io
From: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khalid <samir@openforge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo: GitHub app + private repo webhooks?

Hi Samir — thanks for the note and for uploading the diagram/questionnaire. Really appreciate the detail.

Short answers up front: yes, we have flows for SSO-protected orgs (we can work with SAML/OIDC and org-owner install patterns), webhook filters are configurable at the subscription level, and we can surface runner/action logs in our telemetry pipeline (with a small sidecar to forward logs). I'd love to schedule a 30-minute demo + 15-minute technical pre-call with one of our solutions engineers.

Two asks from my side before we lock time:
1) Who will be the primary technical attendee for the 15-min pre-call? (name + email)
2) Are there any specific PR event types you want us to demonstrate (e.g., draft PRs, code scanning integration, merge queue events)?

Here are a few windows (PST):
- Mon 6/24: 10:00–10:45 or 14:00–14:45
- Tue 6/25: 09:00–09:45 or 16:00–16:45

You can also pick a slot on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-demo?month=2028-06

Looping in Marissa (AE) to help with the calendar and Olga (SE) for the pre-call.

Best,
Avery Johnson
SDR, Redwood Inference
avery@redwood.ai
(Attachment referenced: openforge-security-questions.xlsx)
From: Samir Khalid <samir@openforge.io>
To: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mira Patel <mira@openforge.io>, Rohan Mehta <rohan@openforge.io>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo: GitHub app + private repo webhooks?

Hi Avery — thanks, that sounds great.

Primary technical attendee for the pre-call will be Rohan Mehta <rohan@openforge.io>. We'd like to walk through PR open/close/merge events and also a quick look at Actions logs forwarding. Draft PRs don't matter for us.

Any chance to do the pre-call early next week? Our preferred times (PST): Mon 6/24 at 10:00 or Tue 6/25 at 09:00. Either works for Marissa to join the product demo afterwards.

Also, here's our public GitHub org: https://github.com/openforge — some repositories are private and will require org installation/SSO.

Thanks,
Samir
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khalid <samir@openforge.io>, Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo: GitHub app + private repo webhooks?

Hi Samir — Olga here, Solutions Engineering at Redwood. Thanks for the details and the repo link, that helps a lot. I can take the 15-minute technical pre-call on Mon 6/24 at 10:00 PST. Proposed agenda for the 15-min sync:

- 0:00–2:00: quick intros and access notes (org install vs. token)
- 2:00–8:00: webhook payloads + event filters (show example PR payload)
- 8:00–13:00: runner/Actions logs forwarding pattern and security considerations
- 13:00–15:00: next steps and demo handoff to Marissa for product walkthrough

Prep notes / ask for you: please add rohan@openforge.io to the invite and, if possible, grant org-admin or repo-admin for the private repo we demo (we only need temporary read/install permissions). If there's an internal firewall, let me know and we can provide IP ranges/hostnames.

I'll drop a calendar invite for Mon 6/24 10:00–10:15 PST and include a short pre-call doc.

Cheers,
Olga Petrov
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.ai
(Attachment: se-precall-checklist.md [text, 3KB])
